import { SemapraxPublicGenericException } from "./errors.js";
import { byteView } from "./carrier.js";

function bytesEqual(a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) {
    return false;
  }
  let differs = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < a.length; index += 1) {
    differs |= (a[index] as number) ^ (b[index] as number);
  }
  return differs === 0;
}
